snippets.name: Label Start/End
snippets.description: Creates a complete ZPL label with opening (^XA) and closing (^XZ) tags. The cursor is positioned on the empty line between them, ready for label content.

snippets.name: Text Field
snippets.description: Creates a complete text field with field origin (^FO), scalable font (^A0), field data (^FD), and field separator (^FS). The cursor is positioned at the X coordinate.

snippets.name: Field Data
snippets.description: Creates a field data block with the field separator. Use after setting position and font.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: Data to be printed in the field

snippets.name: Code 128 Barcode
snippets.description: Creates a Code 128 barcode with default settings: 100 dots height, human-readable text below, no UCC check digit.

snippets.name: QR Code
snippets.description: Creates a QR Code with model 2 and magnification factor 5. The 'QA,' prefix enables automatic data mode selection.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: Data to encode in QR code

snippets.name: Data Matrix
snippets.description: Creates a Data Matrix 2D barcode with module height 5 and 200 dots per row.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: Data to encode in Data Matrix

snippets.name: Graphic Box
snippets.description: Draws a graphic box or line. Can be used for borders, separators, or filled rectangles.

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: Width of the box in dots

parameters.name: height
parameters.description: Height of the box in dots (100 default)

snippets.name: Scalable Font
snippets.description: Uses the scalable/TrueType font (font 0) with specified height and width. N = normal orientation.

snippets.name: Change Default Font
snippets.description: Changes the default font for subsequent ^FD commands. Font 0 is the scalable font.

snippets.name: Print Quantity
snippets.description: Sets the print quantity. Parameters: quantity, pause between labels (0=no pause), replicates per serial (1), override pause (Y).

snippets.name: Label Home
snippets.description: Sets the label home position. All subsequent field positions are relative to this point.

snippets.name: Field Block
snippets.description: Creates a multi-line text block with automatic word wrapping. Default: 3 lines max, left justified.
snippets.example: ^FB400,3,0,L,0^FDThis is a long text that will automatically wrap to multiple lines^FS

snippets.name: Get Variable
snippets.description: SGD command to retrieve the value of a printer setting. The second parameter is empty for read operations.

snippets.name: Set Variable
snippets.description: SGD command to set a printer configuration value. Requires appropriate access level.

snippets.name: Execute Action
snippets.description: SGD command to execute a printer action (like clearing logs, calibrating, etc.). The second parameter is usually empty.

snippets.name: Get Languages
snippets.description: Retrieves the list of supported printer languages (ZPL, EPL, etc.).

snippets.name: Get/Set Friendly Name
snippets.description: Gets or sets the printer's friendly name shown in Bluetooth/network discovery.

snippets.name: DHCP Enable
snippets.description: Enables or disables DHCP for automatic IP address assignment.

snippets.name: Media Type
snippets.description: Sets the media type for proper label detection and calibration.

snippets.name: IF...THEN...END IF
snippets.description: ZBI conditional block. Executes statements if condition is true.
snippets.example:
IF count > 10 THEN
    PRINT "High count"
END IF

snippets.name: IF...THEN...ELSE...END IF
snippets.description: ZBI conditional block with else clause for alternative execution path.
snippets.example:
IF status$ = "OK" THEN
    PRINT "Success"
ELSE
    PRINT "Error"
END IF

snippets.name: DO...LOOP WHILE
snippets.description: ZBI loop that executes at least once, then continues while condition is true.

parameters.name: condition
parameters.description: Condition to check after each iteration

snippets.example:
DO
    count = count + 1
LOOP WHILE count < 10

snippets.name: DO...LOOP UNTIL
snippets.description: ZBI loop that executes until condition becomes true.

parameters.name: condition
parameters.description: Condition that stops the loop when true

snippets.name: FOR...TO...NEXT
snippets.description: ZBI counted loop. Iterates from start value to end value.
snippets.example:
FOR i = 1 TO 5
    PRINT i
NEXT

snippets.name: OPEN...CLOSE
snippets.description: ZBI file/channel operations. Opens a communication channel, performs operations, then closes it.

snippets.name: SUB...END SUB
snippets.description: ZBI subroutine definition. Creates a reusable code block that can be called with GOSUB.
snippets.example:
SUB PrintHeader
    PRINT "=== Header ==="
END SUB

snippets.name: Print to Channel
snippets.description: ZBI pattern for sending ZPL commands to the printer from a ZBI program.

snippets.name: ON ERROR Handler
snippets.format:
ON ERROR GOTO ErrorHandler
[main code]
END

ErrorHandler:
RESUME NEXT
snippets.description: ZBI error handling pattern. Catches runtime errors and allows graceful recovery.
snippets.example:
ON ERROR GOTO ErrHandler
result = 10 / x
END

ErrHandler:
PRINT "Division error"
RESUME NEXT

snippets.name: DIM Array
snippets.description: ZBI array declaration. Creates an array with specified number of elements.
